_about: The token tree build_tokens.py turns into tokens.json. farfetch.com is a single-theme luxury storefront on the pulse token layer: white surfaces, #222 ink and #727272 secondary text, sale red #e71d34 and the FARFETCH First gold #a68245, square corners with a 1000px pill radius, 'Farfetch Basis' UI type with 'Nimbus Roman D' editorial serif. The ~590 --colors-* semantics are exported whole under light.<family>.<role>.<state>.<slot>; the legacy palette, type and spacing scales sit under core. Component dimensions and state tracks are measured computed styles.
